preset.description: A named preset (minimal, saas, consumer, crm, projects, helpdesk, chat, commerce, cms, erp, manufacturing, pim, marketplace, scheduling, people, psa, ats, intranet, drive, docs, invoicing, forms, property, field-service, clinic, care, lms, events, legal, spend, contracts, customer-success, logistics, pos, fitness, nonprofit, itsm, compliance, qms, ehs, isms, construction, claims, community, feedback, ai, ai-chat, ai-agents, developer-api, automation, enterprise, admin, everything), a code from app.bettersupabase.com/create, or its URL. defineConfig expands it into blocks and its conventions, and the keys you set win.

projectRef.description: Hosted project ref, read through the Management API read-only SQL endpoint.

accessToken.description: Management API token for projectRef. Defaults to $SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN.

snapshot.description: Read a saved introspection snapshot instead of connecting.

lite.description: Read a Supabase Lite project's schema from [db] driver in supabase/config.toml. On when that key is present; false reads the database like any other project.

source.description: Where codegen reads the database from. Without any of these, $DATABASE_URL and then the local stack are used.

workflow.description: How the SQL modules reach the database: pg-delta (Declarative Schemas 2.0), migra (declarative schemas 1.0) or migrations (written straight into a migration). Unset, supabase/config.toml decides, and pg-delta is the default.

schema.description: The schema of every block's functions and managed tables, unless the block sets its own.

api.description: The Data API schema every block writes its security invoker entry points to, unless the block sets its own api or false.

owner.description: Who a block's rows belong to, unless the block sets its own scope: tenant (the default), user (the signed-in user, no tenants) or none (one shared space every signed-in user uses).

ownTablePolicies.description: Whose policies govern the app's tables a block runs over, unless the block sets its own ownTablePolicies: block (the default) lets a block add its bsb_ policies where none of the app's covers them, and app keeps every bsb_ policy, permissive or restrictive, off them.

exemptRoles.description: Database roles the tenant scope lets through, such as supabase_auth_admin for a security invoker access token hook, which runs without auth.uid(). Each role becomes an or current_user branch. Defaults to none.

tenantScope.description: The restrictive bsb_tenant_scope_* policies, unless a block sets its own tenantScope.

expose.description: Data API grants keyed by `table` or `schema.table`: privileges for authenticated, or per role. Written by the `grants` SQL module and checked by doctor (BS106).

path.description: Path template, e.g. `{organizationId}/{customerId}/logo.webp`, or several for a bucket that stores objects in more than one layout. A last segment `{...rest}` matches one or more segments.

scope.description: `tenant` (default) or `platform`; with `sql`, any scope name the templates take.

sql.description: SQL templates with `{permission}` and `{scope}` the policy calls instead of the access contract, or `provider` for `authorization.functions`.

policy.description: A generated storage policy (tenant, owner, public or none), or a policy through the access contract (tenant_ids_with, is_platform) or `sql` templates such as an authorization provider's.

versioning.description: Keep earlier object versions. bucket.apply() sets it.

lifecycle.description: When noncurrent versions expire. Needs versioning: true.

tables.description: Tables that broadcast change signals (`table` or `schema.table`). Install with `better-supabase add realtime-tables`.

global.description: Tables in `tables` without a tenant column, which broadcast on one topic for every signed-in user.

users.description: Tables in `tables` whose rows belong to one user, mapped to the user column. They broadcast on a topic per user that only that user receives.

policies.description: Writes the realtime.messages policies of the topics `from` exports (defineTopic) to `output` on `upgrade`; `upgrade --check` fails when the file is stale.

topic.description: The template of a topic `policies.from` exports.

values.description: The column or lookup per placeholder. Defaults to the placeholder in snake_case. A row whose topic comes out null is not sent to it.

event.description: The broadcast event name, or one per operation ({ insert, update, delete }). Defaults to the operation.

payload.description: keys (default) sends the primary key and the placeholder values; row sends the whole row, which bypasses column grants. An object is the payload itself: each key is a column, a lookup, or { sql }, an expression on the row {row} (tg_op is the operation).

topic.description: The template of a topic `policies.from` exports.

values.description: The column or lookup per placeholder. Defaults to the placeholder in snake_case.

topics.description: More topics the row change goes to, each with its own values.

functionSchema.description: Schema for a generated function. Defaults to better_supabase, which the Data API does not expose.

changed.description: Columns (database names) whose change lets an UPDATE send. A trigger for updates alone compiles it into its WHEN clause.

when.description: Filters updates: with { changed: [columns] } an UPDATE sends only when one of those columns changed. Inserts and deletes always send.

triggers.description: Broadcast triggers `upgrade` writes to `policies.output` through the topic's trigger(), for topics `policies.from` exports. One topic with column values, a keys or row payload and one event name calls better_supabase.broadcast_topic() (the realtime-tables module); any other trigger gets a generated function.

key.description: The primary key column db.$search({ score: true }) merges by.

hybrid.description: Fuses a full-text ranking over a tsvector column with the vector ranking (reciprocal rank fusion).

boost.description: A SQL expression over the row t the score is multiplied by.

prefilter.description: Columns db.$search({ filter }) narrows before ranking.

predicate.description: A SQL condition over the row t every candidate must meet, applied before ranking.

boostMode.description: How boost combines with the score. Defaults to multiply.

order.description: A SQL order by list over the row t that breaks score ties.

additionalProperties.description: The embedding column, or the column and its search options.

vectorSearch.description: Embedding columns keyed by `table` or `schema.table`. The `vector-search` SQL module writes `search_<table>(query, k)` for each.

claim.description: Top-level claim holding the active tenant id. Defaults to `tenant_id`.

column.description: Column the tenant plugin filters and fills on tenant-scoped tables. Defaults to `tenant_id`.

tenant.description: How the active tenant is found: the claim that holds its id and the column the memberships extension filters by.

scope.description: `scope` of the tenant entries in the `memberships` claim. Defaults to `tenant`.

features.description: Claim holding plan features per tenant. Defaults to `features`.

memberships.description: Claim the memberships hook writes. Defaults to `memberships`.

permissions.description: Claim holding the caller's permission keys per tenant, written by permission_claims(). The hook sets `<permissions>_truncated` when it left keys out. Defaults to `permissions`.

claims.description: Claim names shared by the SQL modules, codegen and runtime defaults.

teamIdsOf.description: The team ids {user} belongs to, as a set. Under the provider model team_ids_of(), saved-views and collections call it.

permissionsFor.description: The permission keys {user} holds in {tenant}, as a text[].

canApprove.description: Whether the caller may decide the tool call {tool} waits on in {tenant}.

scopes.description: OAuth scope to the permission keys it grants a delegated token.

distinctApprover.description: The user who asked for a tool call can't approve it. Default false.

authorization.description: An authorization provider (apiVersion 1) the SQL modules, policies and doctor delegate to.

customer.description: `table.column` or `schema.table.column` holding the Stripe customer id.

key.description: The tenant id column of that table.

memberships.description: Where has_entitlement and feature_claims read memberships: "provider" (the authorization provider's memberIds functions) or "tenant" (better_supabase.memberships). Defaults to "provider" when `authorization` is set.

source.description: Where each tenant's entitlements come from: "stripe-sync" (the Stripe Sync Engine, the default), "custom" (your own better_supabase.tenant_entitlements), or a plan catalog in your tables.

claim.description: The shape of the features claim feature_claims writes: false for {}, or maxTenants (at most that many tenants) and keys (short codes for feature keys).

entitlements.description: Where the `entitlements` SQL module finds each tenant's entitlements: a Stripe customer, a plan catalog or your own function.

idType.description: The id column's type, such as `uuid` or `bigint`.

tenant.description: The tenant column, or `false` for a subject without a tenant. Defaults to `organization_id`, or `<blocks.memberships.entities.organization>_id` when the tenant is renamed.

permissions.description: A permission key per action that `can_subject` checks in the subject's tenant.

scope.description: An authorization provider scope whose ids are this subject's ids.

auditReads.description: Log every read through the blocks' read functions in the audit log, with the NEN 7513 fields. Needs the audit block.

rank.description: The rank key column and the column it is grouped by, for `move()`.

subjects.description: The app's subject types, keyed by type name: the entities blocks attach tags, comments, fields and ranks to. Subject-bound SQL modules read this registry, and the `subjects` module writes `subject_title`, `subject_url` and `can_subject` from it.

blocks.description: The blocks to install and keep in sync: a list of names, or an object keyed by block name whose values set the block's mode, names, permission keys and options. The foundation blocks (tenant, access, updated-at, rls-guard, ...) are configured here too.

adapters.description: The integrations init and add wrote.

tasks.description: The steps gen runs, in order. Without a list: types, plus sql, spec and seed when the project uses them. env runs only when listed.

watchInterval.description: Milliseconds between checks in gen --watch and spec emit --watch.

contentMapper.description: Serve the schema types through the TypeScript 7.1 content mapper: gen writes a slim generated.ts and schema.bsb instead of the type files.

postgrestVersion.description: PostgREST major version written to database.types.ts.

serviceRole.description: Only service_role reaches the table. Models are still generated; doctor (BS106) checks that anon and authenticated have no grants.

insertOptional.description: Database names of not-null columns an insert may leave out because the database fills them, for example from a before insert trigger.

schema.description: JSON Schema enforced by `better-supabase add jsonb-schemas` (pg_jsonschema).
JSON Schema enforced by `better-supabase add jsonb-schemas` (pg_jsonschema).

json.description: Types for jsonb columns, keyed by `table.column`.

codecs.description: Runtime types for timestamps, int8 and numeric columns.

nullableUnderRls.description: Type to-one includes of tables with row level security as nullable, since a policy can hide the related row.

sensitive.description: Columns guarded by the noSensitiveSelect rule (`table.column` or `schema.table.column`).

storagePaths.description: Text columns holding a storage object path (`table.column` or `schema.table.column`), mapped to a `buckets` key or bucket id. Typed as `StoragePath<'bucket-id'>`.

notNull.description: true for the whole result, or the returns table columns that are never null.

functions.description: Function results gen may type as not null, keyed by function name. Results are nullable by default.

generators.description: Generator plugins. Only available in better-supabase.config.ts.

readSets.description: Modules exporting `defineReadSet` results. `gen` compiles them into the `read-sets` SQL module.

openapi.description: Deprecated: use specs. openapi.entry and openapi.output map onto it.

entry.description: Module exporting a defineApi() result (or a function returning one) as api or default. Defaults to openapi.entry.

format.description: A format id: openapi, asyncapi or arazzo.

version.description: Defaults to the format's default version.

output.description: File to write, relative to the root. Defaults to the format's file name.

overlays.description: Overlay files (JSON or YAML), applied in order.

serialize.description: Defaults to yaml when output ends in .yaml or .yml, otherwise json.

ui.description: Also writes a reference page (openapi.html for openapi.json) next to OpenAPI outputs.

failOn.description: The lowest severity that fails spec emit, check and validate.

manifest.description: Also write the diagnostics manifest (JSON) to this file, like spec --manifest.

specs.description: The documents better-supabase spec emit writes (OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, Arazzo).

format.description: Report format. The global --json flag still picks the JSON report.

output.description: Write the report to this file.

prefix.description: Prefix for browser variables, such as NEXT_PUBLIC_; none for no prefix. Detected from the framework by default.

env.description: The env file better-supabase dev env writes.

output.description: Signing key file better-supabase dev keys writes. Defaults to supabase/signing_keys.json.

agents.description: Agent folders skills install writes to. Defaults to the ones the project has, else agents.

$env.description: Overrides per environment, keyed by name. Picked by --env, $BETTER_SUPABASE_ENV, or ci when $CI is set.

environment.description: Keys an environment block overrides. Objects merge into the config; arrays and other values replace.

block.description: The block this entry installs. Defaults to the key; any other key is a second instance of the block it names.

on.description: The record types an attachable block attaches to, as names or keyed by name with settings. Defaults to every record type.

uses.description: Dependency block to the instance it uses, needed when that dependency is installed more than once.

owner.description: Who the block's rows belong to: tenant, user or none. Defaults to database.sql.owner, then tenant.

ownTablePolicies.description: Whose policies govern the app's tables this block runs over: block lets it add its bsb_ policies where none of the app's covers them, app keeps every bsb_ policy, permissive or restrictive, off them. Applies to every app table of the block. Defaults to database.sql.ownTablePolicies, then block.

tenantScope.description: This block's tenant scope policies. Defaults to database.sql.tenantScope.

functions.description: Function name to the name the block writes it under, such as create_organization to start_company.

owner.description: Who the block's rows belong to: tenant, user or none. Defaults to database.sql.owner, then tenant.

ownTablePolicies.description: Whose policies govern the app's tables this block runs over: block lets it add its bsb_ policies where none of the app's covers them, app keeps every bsb_ policy, permissive or restrictive, off them. Applies to every app table of the block. Defaults to database.sql.ownTablePolicies, then block.

tenantScope.description: This block's tenant scope policies. Defaults to database.sql.tenantScope.

scopes.description: OAuth scope to the permission keys it grants a delegated token; merged over authorization.delegation.scopes.

privilege.description: select, insert, update or delete, a column privilege such as `update(title, body)`, or every declared column but some, such as `select(*, -token_hash)`.

triggerValue.description: A column of the changed row, or a lookup: the `select` column of the `from` row (`table` or `schema.table`) whose `key` (default id) equals `via`, a column or another lookup.
